name: Kaze to Oujo-sama to...
source: A visual novel for adults with After Effects animation, themed on the various assaults of Riesz, princess of the land of the wind from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seiken_Densetsu_3]Seiken Densetsu III[/url].
